translations.app-description: Talk with your friends on your own private chat server, hosted on your machine. No more worries about data privacy or third-party services.
translations.not-found-description: Oops! The page you're looking for doesn't exist. It might have been moved or deleted.
translations.form.unknown-error: Something went wrong. Please try again
translations.push.on: On. Your instance wakes this phone when a message arrives; the content stays encrypted.
translations.push.no-distributor: Install a UnifiedPush app, such as ntfy, to get notifications. Then try again.
translations.link.how: On the new device, choose “Sign in with another device” and type your handle and the code shown here.
translations.link.code-valid: Valid for 5 minutes, for one attempt.
translations.link.confirm: Give access to your account to “{$INTERPOLATION}”?
translations.link.wrong-code-a: The other device typed a wrong code
translations.backup.warning: Anyone with this key controls your account. Only show it to save it somewhere safe.
translations.logout.warning: This removes your account from this device. Without another signed-in device or your saved secret key, it's lost for good.
translations.link-join.how: On a device where you're signed in, open your account and choose “Link a device”.
translations.login.handle-invalid: Enter your full handle, like pseudo@instance
translations.link.wrong-code: Wrong code. Ask the other device for a new one
translations.link.code-expired: No device shows this code. Check it, or ask for a new one
translations.register.keychain-error: Your system keychain is unavailable, so your key can't be saved
translations.login.nsec-invalid: This isn't a valid private key
translations.login.key-mismatch: This key doesn't belong to this handle
translations.backup.why: Your account lives only on your devices: no server keeps your key. If you lose this device without another one or this key, your account is lost. Keep it in a password manager.
translations.dm.empty: No conversations yet. Search someone above.
translations.group.title: New group
translations.group.limits: Up to 10 people, you included. Members can't change later: adding someone starts a new group.
translations.group.invalid: A group has a name and 2 to 10 people
translations.switch-view: Switch between communities and private messages
translations.community.invalid-invite: This invite is wrong or was revoked
translations.community.invalid: This doesn't look like an invite
translations.community.refused: The instance refused. Is your account still registered on it?
translations.community.empty: No community yet. Create one or join with an invite, with “+” at the top.
translations.header.e2e-hint: Only the people in this conversation can read it. Your instance can't.
translations.invite.title: Invite people to {$INTERPOLATION}
translations.invite.hint: Anyone with this invite can join the community, whatever their instance.
translations.leave.title: Leave {$INTERPOLATION}?
translations.leave.hint: To come back, you'll need a new invite.
translations.intro.channel: This is the start of the channel.
translations.intro.private: This is the start of your conversation. It's end-to-end encrypted: your instance can't read it.
translations.chat.nothing: The cat is napping. Pick a conversation on the left, or find someone by their @handle@instance.
